sentences.text: The Clean Water Act prohibits discharging oil or oily waste in any amount that causes a film or sheen on the water or sludge below the surface.
If a spill happens, report it right away to the National Response Center at one, eight hundred, four two four, eight eight zero two.
Never use dish soap or chemical dispersants to make a sheen disappear.
That just sinks the oil, and it’s a violation itself.
Carry absorbent pads to soak up spills and oil in the bilge, and never pump oily bilge water overboard.
